findings.summary: read_resource accepts caller and owner but never compares them, returning the resource value to any caller regardless of ownership.
findings.evidence: read_resource() { local caller=$1 owner=$2 value=$3; printf '%s\n' "$value"; }

findings.summary: The contract assertion only checks that displayName is present, so it would not catch a regression that adds sensitive extra fields to the public response.
A missing or non-numeric counter file yields an empty n, so the arithmetic silently resets the sequence to 1 instead of failing.
The _or_fail name promises explicit failure handling that the body does not implement, relying only on implicit exit-status propagation.
